message:
I can see the vulnerability. In `expand_include`, when the path starts with a double quote `"`, it does `olen -= 2`. If `olen` is less than 2 (e.g., the path is just `"` or empty), this causes an underflow making `olen` a huge value. This leads to a negative-size-param in the subsequent `memcpy` or `rcstr_alloc`.

Let me look at the fuzz target to understand how the input is processed.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/sudo -name "*fuzz*" -type f | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
